programme.title: LAmour perdu de Lewbert
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent que Lewbert avait une petite amie et qu'il était heureux. Ils décident de retrouver Marta en espérant qu'elle lui apportera à nouveau le bonheur. Mais la vie n'est pas toujours comme on l'imagine...

programme.title: Le concours de beauté
programme.desc: Sam révèle à Carly et Freddie avoir participé à un concours de beauté lorsqu'elle était plus jeune.

programme.title: Le rendez-vous de Spencer
programme.desc: Sam se retrouve accidentellement en prison et Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour que l'émission ait lieu malgré tout. Ils demandent alors l'aide de Spencer, qui a malheureusement un rendez-vous ce soir là.

programme.title: dans lespace
programme.desc: iCarly se voit proposer de tourner un web show exceptionnel dans l'Espace grâce à un milliardaire qui souhaite promouvoir un nouveau concept de voyage spatial...

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: A la suite d'un reportage aux infos, Carly est bien décidée à prouver à tout le monde que BIGFOOT, un primate humanoïde, existe réellement.

programme.title: Freddie déménage!
programme.desc: Freddie ne supporte plus que ça mère le traite comme un bébé et déménage. Carly et Sam monte une affaire de photographie animalière, mais sont vite dérangées par d'autres photographes ne supportant pas la concurrence.

programme.title: Vague de chaleur
programme.desc: A cause de la vague de chaleur, la ville subit une panne de courant. Spencer, toujours plein da ressource, met en marche un générateur électrique et un climatiseur ultra performant.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Miranda, l'actrice qui joue le rôle d'iCarly convoque Jerry, le comédien jouant Spencer sur le plateau pour lui remonter les bretelles.

programme.title: Lanniversaire de Carly
programme.desc: C'est l'anniversaire de Carly, Spencer veut lui faire un cadeau original. Il fabrique une lampe avec des bonbons qui prend feu. La chambre de Carly brûle entièrement. Grâce à l'argent de l'assurance,

programme.title: Je le veux
programme.desc: Carly reçoit une demande originale : Gordon, un fan de l'émission, veut demander la main de sa petite amie, Jodi, en direct. Jodi accepte la demande en mariage et convie Carly et ses amis au mariage!

programme.title: Les Blaguo-shirts
programme.desc: Sam et Carly organisent une vente aux enchères avec tout un tas d'objets qui leur ont servi pendant l'émission iCarly. Le t-shirt rigolo remporte un succès.

programme.title: Le roi de la blague
programme.desc: Carly n'a jamais fait de blague et demande à Spencer de l'aider. Il fini par accepter, mais ses vieux démons le rattrapent. Lorsqu'il était en troisième, on l'appelait le roi de la blague, jusqu'au jour où.

programme.title: Sam et sa mère
programme.desc: Freddie filme un vol au Groovy Smoothie, permettant d'identifier le criminel. Mais les journalistes révèlent le nom et l'adresse du jeune garçon en direct.

programme.title: Pitié pour Nevel!
programme.desc: Nevel, l'ennemi numéro un de iCarly vient de se ridiculiser sur le net en criant sur une petite fille dans un supermarché... Désormais tout le monde le déteste, pour la plus grande joie de la bande d'iCarly.

programme.title: The House at the End of Time
programme.desc: Dulce est une jeune mère qui a des hallucinations. Elle voit des apparitions dans sa maison qui un jour déclenche la prophétie et tue tous les habitants sauf elle. Trente ans plus tard elle se réinstalle dans sa demeure afin d'élucider le mystère.

programme.title: Time served
programme.desc: Quand un enfant tue son beau-père violent, sa mère se dénonce et est condamnée à une longue peine de prison.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Tandis qu'un commando d'élite de l'armée américaine tend une embuscade à des rebelles, le professeur Lovecraft guide plusieurs de ses élèves dans une mission archéologique. Une étudiante est attaquée par un ptérodactyle.

programme.title: Malevolence 3: Killer
programme.desc: Martin Bristol revient là où tout a commencé : la maison où il a été kidnappé. Mais il n'est plus le garçon qui a disparu il y a plus de dix ans. Torturé et maltraité par son ravisseur psychotique, Graham Sutter, Martin a subi des dommages irréparables. Tapi dans l'ombre de la banlieue, il traque et tue sans remords.

programme.title: A.R.I
programme.desc: Noah, un jeune garcon un peu geek, découvre un robot qui semble abandonné dans une poubelle du laboratoire où travaille son père. Il le ramène à la maison et tente de le réparer.

programme.title: Fabuleuses Aventures à Oz
programme.desc: La jeune Dorothée part pour le monde de OZ avec un groupe d'amis.

programme.title: Les Aventures de Billy Stone, le médaillon sacré
programme.desc: L'archéologue Michael Stone a passé sa vie à rechercher un médaillon magique. C'est finalement son fils Billy qui parvient à le retrouver, mais une mauvaise manipulation libère le pouvoir de l'artefact. L'adolescent et son amie Allie se retrouvent projetés dans le temps et l'espace.

programme.title: Halloween Island
programme.desc: Kai, Leilani et Eddie, trois enfants que tout oppose, doivent mettre de côté leurs différences pour sauver Hawaï d'un terrible démon légendaire qu'ils ont réveillé par erreur. Face aux plus grands dangers, les enfants vont comprendre ce que sont le courage, l'amitié et les traditions.

programme.title: L'Esprit d'Halloween
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un magasin d'Halloween ouvre dans un centre commercial désert, trois amis, pensant avoir grandi, décident d'y passer la nuit enfermés. Mais leur soirée amusante tourne vite en lutte pour survivre face à des événements terrifiants.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer
programme.desc: Un mystérieux tueur élimine les plus grands maîtres en arts martiaux, laissant derrière lui une arme secrète comme signature. Lorsqu'un expert en kung-fu emprisonné reconnaît la technique utilisée, il conclut un marché avec la police : aider à traquer le meurtrier en échange de sa liberté.

programme.title: Alana : Déesse de Justice
programme.desc: Séparée de ses parents à la naissance suite à une éruption volcanique, puis ayant grandi dans une société très injuste, Alana tente de comprendre le mystère de ses crises de colère. Quand elle apprend qu'elle est la réincarnation de Sri Asih, la déesse de justice, elle va mettre ses super-pouvoirs au service du bien contre la corruption et le crime organisé.

programme.title: Orc Wars
programme.desc: Une armée d'Orcs est envoyée dans notre monde pour l'envahir. Un ancien militaire est désigné malgré lui comme étant LE tueur d'Orcs et l'unique sauveur de l'humanité. L'affrontement ultime peut commencer…

programme.title: Blood Circus
programme.desc: Un ancien champion du monde de MMA se voit enrôlé dans un club de combat souterrain appelé « Blood Circus » et se retrouver forcé de se battre pour survivre et sauver sa famille.

programme.title: Suicide Express
programme.desc: Valentin aime les comédies musicales d'antan, Adélaïde non. Valentin aime la vie, Adélaïde un peu moins. Quoi qu'il en soit, il n'a peur de rien pour la convaincre, pas même du ridicule.

programme.title: On ne badine pas avec Rosette
programme.desc: Alice reprend du jour au lendemain le rôle de Rosette dans On ne badine pas avec l'amour. Lors de sa première représentation, elle se retrouve mêlée à un jeu un peu particulier entre les acteurs.

programme.title: L'hiver est proche
programme.desc: Louise, la trentaine, travaille comme agent des espaces verts, dans une forêt qui borde la ville. Son travail : faire de la médiation, empêcher les jeunes de faire du scooter dans les bois, et les familles, des barbecues. Un Camp de Roms chassé d'une ville voisine s'est s'installé dans cette forêt.

programme.title: Chahut
programme.desc: A Dunkerque, pendant le carnaval, un carnavaleux se retrouve seul dans les rues désertes. Il erre un moment avant d'arriver sur la plage où il découvre que les bruits du carnaval proviennent de la mer. Il décide alors de s'enfoncer dans l'eau et disparaît.

programme.title: Adieu Molitor
programme.desc: Michel est un espoir déçu du football qui n'a pas toujours tiré un trait sur ses rêves de gloire. Au jour le jour, il trouve refuge dans un prolongement poussif de son adolescence pleine de promesse et tente de ranimer les fantômes d'un passé à jamais révolu.

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Eclipse est un poème visuel qui montre l'intimité d'un couple dans les heures précédant la naissance de leur premier enfant. Le passé présent et le futur sont mélangés dans une série d'images qui évoquent la solitude de ces deux-là dans un espace familial et tour à tour exotique. En attendant l'arrivée du nouvel être, un événement marquera le début de cette nouvelle étape. Une éclipse lunaire sera le point de départ d'un changement de paradigme dans la nouvelle famille.

programme.title: Veuillez ne pas tenter d'ouvrir les portes
programme.desc: Un train, immobilisé, de nuit, en pleine campagne. Un accident semble s'être produit. Les passagers ont été évacués, l'enquête est close, le trafic va reprendre lorsqu'un spécialiste parvient sur les lieux. Il a quinze minutes pour reconstituer les circonstances de l'accident et aboutir à sa propre conclusion.

programme.title: Plaine orientale
programme.desc: C'est le printemps. Dans la Plaine Orientale Corse, la récolte des fruits bat son plein. De nombreux travailleurs venus de loin y trouvent un emploi pour la saison. Mathilde, une jeune cueilleuse de pomelos, évolue entre les deux équipes de son patron. D'un côté, des Européens, de l'autre, des Maghrébins.

programme.title: Truth or Consequences
programme.desc: Truth or Consequences est une ville du Nouveau-Mexique. Ronan Guillou en a fait une étape de ses investigations photographiques américaines. En mêlant photos, son et textes il nous propose ici un portrait sensible de la ville et de ses habitants.

programme.title: Du vent dans les épaules
programme.desc: Si vous dîtes à votre médecin “j'ai un peu de vent dans les épaules”, il va vous regarder de travers... Mais pour un chinois, c'est absolument évident !

programme.title: Gamin
programme.desc: Un gamin, Paulo, bricole sa voiture, une Peugeot 205 toit ouvrant, aidé par ses potes, pour aller retrouver son père, un père pas vu, plus vu depuis des années. Un père qu'il n'en peut plus d'espérer.

programme.title: La Cinémamecque
programme.desc: La Cinémamecque est une série de courts métrages en stop motion, une histoire du cinéma modelée, animée et analysée et un ciné-club.

programme.title: L'Homme des bois
programme.desc: Jean Douchet à la Cinématek présente L'Homme des bois et la philosophie d'Henry David Thoreau.

programme.title: Le Terrier
programme.desc: Le Terrier est le dernier texte de Kafka, un monologue vertigineux en forme d'adresse, laissé inachevé. Planches dépareillées et palettes de guingois plantées en intérieur en seront le terrain, Strike le corps, lecteur, interprète et protagoniste. Du terrier-lieu au terrier-texte.

programme.title: Les cœurs vaillants
programme.desc: Jo, J.G. et Daniel, amis d'enfance, ont monté un groupe de rock, “Les Coeurs Vaillants”. Ils se rendent à leur tout premier concert.

programme.title: Sœur et frère
programme.desc: Une jeune fille vit une relation très complice avec son frère aîné.

programme.title: Mal de terre
programme.desc: Un marin russe revient en ville après un très long voyage.

programme.title: Écart de conduite
programme.desc: Pour la neuvième fois, Chloé tente de passer son permis de conduire.

programme.title: Masques
programme.desc: Deux masques se font face sous une multitude de regards inquiétants. Un signal est donné, commence alors une danse, un combat rituel.

programme.title: L'homme d'à côté
programme.desc: Film sur François Truffaut, l'amour et le cinéma.

programme.title: King Crab Attack
programme.desc: Trouville-sur-Mer, Basse-Normandie. Une petite station balnéraire sans histoire. Basile, garde-côte dans la région est le témoin depuis quelques temps d'étranges événements. Simples coïncidences ? Et si tous ces événements n'étaient que l'avant-goût d'une tragédie à l'ampleur catastrophique ?

programme.title: Vikingar
programme.desc: Islande, an 934 après J.-C. : Magnus, guerrier viking de retour de la guerre, doit affronter en combat singulier le redoutable Bjarni qui lui a volé sa femme et son enfant. Leur rivalité ne fait que commencer, elle se poursuivra plus de mille ans plus tard.

programme.title: Ama
programme.desc: Au Japon dans les années 50, une jeune américaine visite un village avec son mari militaire et un groupe d'amis. Prise d'admiration pour le paysage, elle se détache du groupe, elle fait la connaissance de Namiko, une jeune pêcheuse “ama”.

programme.title: Chantou
programme.desc: Chantou, 45 ans, représentante en matelas bio et fumeuse impénitente, enceinte et étourdie, se retrouve le temps d'une soirée dans la ville de province où vit Yves, son fils aîné avec qui elle est brouillée. S'étant fait voler sa camionnette, Chantou compte bien se faire héberger chez lui et lui annoncer sa grossesse. Mais les retrouvailles ne se passent pas comme prévues. Seule dans une ville inconnue, commence alors pour Chantou un itinéraire nocturne qui va la chambouler.

programme.title: Without Sugar
programme.desc: Une journée à New York avec Sophie, une française, américaine d'adoption. Son regard sur la vie, la gourmandise, la tentation et les restrictions alimentaires…

programme.title: People are strange
programme.desc: Julien se considère comme le sosie légitime de Jim Morrison. Il gagne sa vie au cimetière du Père Lachaise en distrayant les touristes venus voir la tombe de la rockstar. Le jour où il apprend que la dépouille de son idole va être rapatriée en Californie, Julien entrprend de voler avec son ami Aldo les restes du Lizard King.

programme.title: Chasse royale
programme.desc: Angélique, treize ans, vient d'une famille nombreuse de la banlieue de Valenciennes. Ce jour-là dans son collège, on lui propose de passer un casting.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: D'Artagnan
programme.desc: Trois amis – Adrian, Charlotte et Viktor – partent explorer une grotte dans la nature norvégienne. Tous trois sont expérimentés dans ce genre d'aventure et ont bien préparé leur expédition. Des tensions relationnelles compliquent toutefois le voyage : Charlotte est en couple avec Adrian, mais elle et Viktor ont déjà été ensemble, et Viktor a encore des sentiments pour elle. De plus, quelqu'un semble les suivre, même à l'intérieur de la grotte.

programme.title: TOMIRIS
programme.desc: Voici l'histoire de la grande reine des steppes, la légendaire Tomyris. Destinée à devenir une guerrière habile, elle devra survivre à la perte de ses proches et unir les tribus scythes/sakas sous son autorité.

programme.title: Imagine
programme.desc: Une rock-star vieillissante ne souhaite pas changer ses habitudes de vie, jusqu'à ce que son agent lui fasse ouvrir une lettre gardée secrète pendant 40 ans, écrite de la main de John Lennon, le célèbre membre des Beatles. Suite à cette découverte inattendue, Danny Collins va chercher à redécouvrir sa famille et à trouver l'amour.

programme.title: The Little Unicorn
programme.desc: Un conte de fées moderne vraiment enchanteur, avec des effets spéciaux époustouflants. La vie heureuse de la jeune Polly et de son grand-père est bouleversée par la mort de son cheval préféré et la naissance magique d'un bébé licorne dans leur ferme. Lorsque le village découvre son secret, certains de ses personnages les plus rusés tentent de voler la créature mystique.

programme.title: Princess In Love
programme.desc: L'histoire scandaleuse et véridique de la liaison entre le capitaine James Hewitt et Lady Diana Spencer, qui a détruit un mariage royal et stupéfié la monarchie britannique.

programme.title: The Old Way
programme.desc: Colton Briggs, un ancien bandit armé, tient désormais une épicerie et vit tranquillement avec sa famille.

programme.title: L'île de Pascali
programme.desc: La tromperie est un mode de vie sur la belle île égéenne, où un triangle romantique se développe entre un espion de l'empire turc en déclin, un archéologue anglais et une expatriée sensuelle.

programme.title: Le Sourire De Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Julia Roberts, lauréate d'un Oscar, brille dans ce film au casting étourdissant : Kirsten Dunst, Julia Stiles, Maggie Gyllenhaal et l'oscarisée Marcia Gay Harden.

programme.title: Pas un mot
programme.desc: Le psychiatre Nathan Conrad mène une vie paisible. Quand sa fille est kidnappée, il doit débloquer un code enfoui dans l'esprit dérangé de sa nouvelle patiente.

programme.title: Evolver
programme.desc: Kyle Baxter gagne un robot nommé Evolver qui joue l'adversaire dans un jeu de laser-tag. Mais les choses prennent une tournure sinistre lorsque le robot commence à faire preuve d'une dangereuse soif de violence.

programme.title: Le Secret: Oser le rêve
programme.desc: Tiré du livre révolutionnaire "The Secret," The Secret : Dare to Dream est l'histoire de Miranda Wells (Katie Holmes), une jeune veuve travailleuse qui se bat pour élever seule ses trois enfants. Une puissante tempête amène dans sa vie un terrible défi et un homme mystérieux, Bray Johnson (Josh Lucas). En quelques jours seulement, la présence de Bray ravive l'esprit de la famille, mais il porte un secret qui pourrait tout faire basculer.

programme.title: Cadence
programme.desc: Martin Sheen debutta alla regia con un film drammatico ambientato nella prigione militare di una base statunitense nella Germania occidentale degli anni '60. Un giovane soldato bianco viene inviato in una carcere popolata da soli detenuti neri, con l'accusa di ubriachezza e comportamento ribelle. Anziché divenire vittima dell'odio razziale, il soldato si allea con gli altri reclusi e si ribella all'estremamente bigotto e tirannico direttore della prigione.

programme.title: Une vie inachevée
programme.desc: Une femme malchanceuse prête à tout pour subvenir aux besoins de sa fille, emménage chez son beau-père qu'elle connaît mal. Avec le temps, ils apprennent à se pardonner et à guérir d'anciennes blessures.

programme.title: Le Secret: Oser le rêve
programme.desc: Tiré du livre révolutionnaire "The Secret," The Secret : Dare to Dream est l'histoire de Miranda Wells (Katie Holmes), une jeune veuve travailleuse qui se bat pour élever seule ses trois enfants. Une puissante tempête amène dans sa vie un terrible défi et un homme mystérieux, Bray Johnson (Josh Lucas). En quelques jours seulement, la présence de Bray ravive l'esprit de la famille, mais il porte un secret qui pourrait tout faire basculer.

programme.title: Une idée de génie
programme.desc: Deux amis s'associent et rencontrent le succès.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Marcus Graham, responsable d'une agence de publicités, est le célibataire par excellence, chaque fois une nouvelle fille à son bras. Voici qu'arrive Jacqueline, sa nouvelle chef et Graham se retrouve éconduit pour la première fois de sa vie !

programme.title: Siberia
programme.desc: Un négociant en diamants tente de vendre des pierres aux origines douteuses à des acheteurs russes. Alors que la vente commence à capoter, sa rencontre avec une femme dans une petite ville de Sibérie tourne à l'obsession.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Deux beaux mecs font irruption dans l'univers de Cher : un nouveau camarade d'école sexy et son ex demi-frère à l'esprit carré mais bien mignon. Elle apprend maintenant que lorsqu'il s'agit d'amour, elle est nulle.

programme.desc: Retrouvez les petits détails des plus grands films et des séries majeures.

programme.title: Walt Disney, le rêveur éveillé
programme.desc: Mêlant archives et interviews, ce documentaire dévoile qui était l'homme derrière le légendaire Walt Disney.

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.10
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La carrière, la vie privée, la filmographie et les secrets de vos stars hollywoodiennes préférées.

programme.title: Good Advice
programme.desc: Ryan Turner est un jeune banquier-investisseur qui connaît un succès incomparable. Ryan court beaucoup trop les jupons et couche régulièrement avec ses clientes, y compris, malheureusement pour lui, Veronica Simpson, la femme de son plus important client, Donald Simpson.

programme.title: Un secret bien gardé
programme.desc: Une jeune femme, responsable marketing, effectue son premier voyage d'affaires à Glasgow. Sur le chemin du retour, son avion traverse une zone de turbulences. Angoissée à l'idée de perdre la vie, elle livre quelques petits secrets à son voisin.

programme.title: Retour vers l'amour
programme.desc: Josie, responsable marketing, rentre chez elle lorsqu'elle devient la tutrice inattendue de sa nièce et de son neveu. Là-bas, elle renoue avec Cooper, son petit ami du lycée.

programme.title: Alone together
programme.desc: June, critique gastronomique, se rend dans le nord de l'État de New York pour une courte escapade romantique afin d'échapper à la pandémie qui sévit en ville.

programme.title: Love, Romance & Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de Chocolatier Rayal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolats uniques, mais gagneront-t-ils sans qu'ils y perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: Une mariee en cavale
programme.desc: Juste avant son mariage Lisa plaque son fiancé infidèle Max et prend le bus direction l'aéroport pour quitter l'Afrique. Le destin veut que son ancien amoureux Vic venu ici elle cinq ans plus tôt voyage dans ce même bus. Il convoie incognito le Nuage d'Anamanga un diamant légendaire. Mais le car est attaqué et la pierre tant convoitée est dérobée. Menottés l'un à l'autre Lisa et Vic prennent la fuite dans la jungle...

programme.title: Arrête de pleurer Pénélope
programme.desc: Trois amis d'enfance qui ne s'étaient pas vus depuis longtemps se retrouvent à l'enterrement de la tante de l'un d'entre eux.

programme.title: Love Hacks
programme.desc: Sam, coach en relations amoureuses, est convaincue qu'elle peut réparer n'importe quelle histoire d'amour et crée un podcast pour le prouver. Mais Josh, son producteur plein d'humour, la met au défi de tester ses propres sentiments.

programme.title: The Love Gala
programme.desc: Lorsque Kate se voit confier l'organisation du Gala du Jardin de sa mère, le plus grand événement festif de l'année, elle doit trouver un compromis avec le nouveau directeur, au caractère opposé, du jardin botanique.

programme.title: The Ten
programme.desc: Une parodie en dix histoires courtes inspirées des dix commandements.

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: Au début des années 2000, une adolescente catholique et bien rangée découvre la tentation sur un chat aol.

programme.title: Wedding Bell Blues
programme.desc: Trois femmes partagent un appartement. Un abandon soudain les conduit à Las Vegas.

programme.title: Romance de rêve
programme.desc: Un plombier solitaire se fait passer pour un réalisateur pour rencontrer des femmes.

programme.title: Une nouvelle tradition pour Noël
programme.desc: Carol vit pour Noël et sa ville la surnomme « Carol de Noël ». Mais l'arrivée d'un homme séduisant qui remet en question ses traditions pourrait bouleverser ses certitudes.

programme.title: Un Noël tout doux
programme.desc: Jess quitte sa carrière pour participer à un concours de mode de Noël avec Andrew, père célibataire et éleveur d'alpagas. Ensemble, ils pourraient sauver la ferme… et trouver l'amour.

programme.title: Noël avec ma fille
programme.desc: Deux parents célibataires entrevoient la possibilité d'un Noël romantique, mais découvrent que leurs filles sont en proie à une rivalité féroce à l'école. Lorsque cette rivalité dégénère, l'espoir et la réconciliation pourront-ils mener chacun à un Noël paisible et joyeux ?

programme.title: Le ranch de mes rêves
programme.desc: Kate, jeune actrice citadine, part vivre dans un ranch pour préparer son prochain rôle. Mais en aidant Hunter à sauver son exploitation, elle découvre une vie et des sentiments inattendus.

programme.title: À la recherche du bonheur

programme.title: The Nanny S1E9
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. programme.desc: Planning a wedding usually involves some chaos, even for David Tutera. But he's about to meet a bride whose zen themed wedding has her so calm, David's not sure why he's there. First of all, her décor is beautiful, bridesmaid's dresses are lovely and her wedding gown is absolutely perfect for her ceremony. So why is he there? David meets the brides Mother who is a big part of Jessica's wedding. And even Mom, a big part of the wedding, is good to go. Jessica and David go to her reception venue, and it's better suited for a rehearsal dinner than a wedding, and there's NO dance floor! Where will the bride and groom have their first dance? So now David knows what he needs to do. First thing, a gorgeous gown for the mother of the bride, followed by a one-of-a-kind, AMAZING, party dress. How about a change of venue to a chic loft space fit with a water filled dance floor? And the surprises don't end there. Jessica and her fiancé XX get dance lessons from a celebrity dance instructor and then a first for David and his bride, trapeze lessons to let her “let loose” of all her wedding stress! When the big day comes, our zen bride experiences a magical big day filled with water, fire, light and love.

Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

A lynx out hunting, red deer stags roar to call their harems together, wild boar forage in dead leaves looking for nuts. When one considers how densely populated it is, Germany is home to a surprising number of different species. Around one third of the country is covered in forest. Forests enters a world full of magic and shows the secretive inhabitants you won't see when out for a walk. Spring in the Black Forest brings out the cherry blossom. Not long now, and the fruit used to make the famous Black Forest Gâteau will appear. A doe has deposited its fawn in the high grass under the trees. Nearby, a vixen is on the look-out for food for her cubs. She would just about be able to handle the fawn ... Life in the forest is full of drama. Humans are rarely seen, the animal adventures take place behind a thick curtain of leaves. The wildcat and the lynx have managed to reconquer some regions from which they had long disappeared. For rare animals like black stork and stag beetle, the woods offer a last refuge. The best nature film-makers in Germany spent more than five years travelling the country from the Harz mountains to the Bavarian Forest, from Saxonian Switzerland to the Palatinate Forest, collecting material on the secret lives of forest dwellers.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: After years of lockdown, the Ghoulz are back at SEMA! But first they need to finish the tribute 1970 Dodge T/A Challenger. This gorgeous custom build in K2 Go Mango will certainly stop traffic, but at this year's SEMA show it has competition. The aptly named, Phoenix 'Cuda, will make its SEMA debut in 2022! Whether you're team Chally or team 'Cuda, the SEMA showroom is catching fire!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Fresh from the flight and still exhausted from the SEMA show in Las Vegas, Mark and the Ghoulz get back to the grind. Will eagerly prepares to paint his very first 1970 AAR 'Cuda. But with Mark breathing down his neck and micromanaging his methods, Will's rebellious nature is stirred up. Meanwhile, Josh is doing some heavy metal work on another 1970 'Cuda that was once thought to be a 440 6 barrel, automatic.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The team takes on the biggest engine challenge of their lives! A numbers matching 383 for a 1971 'Cuda, that has multiple, massive, freeze cracks in the block. Mark puts a local shop to the test, as they attempt to save an engine, that at one time, would not be savable. But with no promises and mounting expenses, will this massive engine gamble pay off? Meanwhile in the metal shop, the ghouls tackle another tribute wing car, a Daytona.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When the local junkyard closes its doors, Mark and Dougie have to rescue an old friend from the earliest days of Graveyard Carz. At the shop, Will continues to push the 1970 AAR 'Cuda through paint and into assembly, and the team continues work on a very original, one owner, 1970 Super Bee, 383, air conditioning car, in Plum Crazy! With most of the car rusted out, this massive reconstruction may be thwarted by a scarcity of parts.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Tony D'Agostino makes another trip to the west coast, Mark Worman takes the opportunity to revisit the Brothers Car Collection in Salem, Oregon to do a deep dive on a 1971 Hemi 'Cuda that shares history with the Sandwich Man himself. This one-of-a-kind Mopar was purchased by Zachary Taylor Reynolds, grandson of tobacco tycoon R.J. Reynolds, and is considered to be the highest optioned, lowest mile, most original 1971 Hemi 'Cuda in existence.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Vanishing Point Challenger has not disappeared from view. After years of gathering rust in the Graveyard, this 1970 Alpine White Challenger R/T tribute car has been cleaned up, and has received most of its sheet metal. It's time to wrap up metal with the tail end of the car. Meanwhile, Will experiences deja vu as he paints another '69 Roadrunner in A4 Silver, nearly identical in color to the recent Graveyard Dreamz car for Don Jones, Jr.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Tune in to the season finale of Graveyard Carz and find out what made this season one for the record books! On this special episode, Mark and the Ghoulz count and catalog every significant restoration, from the very first 1970 Road Runner in season 1 to the infamous 1971 Phoenix 'Cuda in season 16. The restorations of the past will be held up against the new restorations in this last particularly prolific season.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Finally, an episode of GYC that is all about A Bodies! The rarely seen Mopar A Body is revealed, not once but twice! Two A Body beasts that coincidently arrived around the same time also happen to be getting done at the same time. Mark and Will duke it out over their favorite A bodies: the 1969, A57, 383 4-speed, 'Cuda in B5 Blue for Mark and the overly optioned, one of a kind, 1971, Mr. Norm's, 340 six-pack, Demon, in FE5 Rallye Red for Will.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: The Gray Knight

Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a top-notch vocalist and songwriter Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)! This artist first made herself known to the public in 2010 through Superstar K2 and caused a real sensation with her rendition of Kelly Clarkson's Because of You. The following year she made her official debut with the first mini-album The First Day and then took part in the soundtracks of numerous TV series and films starting with School 2013. Recently Kim Bo-kyung (Neon) dropped the new digital single Why Am I? It's her first new song in 5 months with an intense guitar riff and band sound. 5 months back she released the song Let's Walk Through The Flower Path to offer a message of comfort to listeners as we are all going through the pandemic era. In this episode this musician performs That night That day (010)Unknown Call Let's Walk Through The Flower Path Love Yourself Why Am I? and Don't Think You're Alone. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)'s kaleidoscopic musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Meaningful Stone! Since releasing her debut single Camera in My Dreams in July 2017 she has garnered much attention with her self-produced music videos and live performance videos on YouTube. Naturally she became one of the most aspiring indie musicians in the Korean music scene who was also highly praised by renowned music critic and writer Bae Soon-tak. This past September Meaningful Stone released her first full-length album a call from my dreams which is named after the lead single off the album. As the title implies the song is about a call she received in her dreams when she was struggling with life's ups and downs. As opposed to reality she was continuously speaking words of love to herself while dreaming. She shares that hopeful message with listeners to offer a moment of comfort. In this episode Meaningful Stone performs a call from my dream nameless treasure hunt if I grow up as if and beep-boop-beep-boop. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and check out her unpredictable yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is guitarist and singer-songwriter Jukjae! This artist initially made his reputation in the music scene as a session guitarist composer and arranger. Then in April 2014 he released a self-written song View through the compilation album bright #2 and his debut album One Word in November officially starting a singing career of his own. Thanks to his dexterity in playing guitar he has played with a number of top musicians including Park Hyo-shin Kim Dong-ryul IU and more. Last month in November Jukjae released his second mini-album 2006 the year Jukjae describes as “the most beautiful and innocent time” in his life. With the lead single Shining My 2006 he hopes people will look back at the time they were at their brightest and happiest to escape reality for a brief moment. In this episode Jukjae performs Shining My 2006 The Door Do You Want To Walk With Me? Let's Go See the Stars and View. Tune in to I'm LIVE and take a glimpse into his artistry!

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats
programme.sub-title: S01:E03 - The Secret Lives of Pumas
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Pumas are also known by the names of cougar or mountain lion. However, these cats are only distantly related to lions. They're much more closely related to cheetahs. And while pumas are often found in mountains, they're just as at home in the lowlands, dense forests, treeless pampers, or deserts.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats
programme.sub-title: S01:E04 - The Secret Lives of Lions
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Lions differ from all other cats in that they are highly social, forming prides of up to 35 animals. There are now thought to be fewer than 15,000 lions remaining in Kenya's Masai Mara, a drop of 75% in 50 years.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: Finding a mate, building a nest, and raising kids are all part of the whole reproductive behavior thing. But it's not as easy as it sounds. First, you've got to sift through lots of possible partners to find the one with the best genes to keep your family line going. Nesting involves finding some space and then guarding it fiercely, while raising the little ones takes loads of energy as you have to feed, teach, and keep them safe until they grow up. This episode dives into the ins and outs of how creatures go about their reproductive business.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
